answer: To defend against Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, every agent must lock $50,000 in a smart contract. Second, agents perform verifiable tasks to earn a reputation score. Third, this score is tied directly to the locked assets. Fourth, any proven malice results in immediate slashing. An attacker would need $1,500,000 in bonds and 60 days of rigorous verification to fake identities. This protocol is as clear as quartz, structured like a sonnet, and rises above chaos like a lotus. It ensures that every node has real skin in the game.
